items.subject: rows of modest weathered headstones in a sun-baked Western Australian cemetery, no people present
items.action: the rows stretch on in silence, a few bunches of faded flowers drying in the heat
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction runs down the long rows toward a pale horizon
items.setting: suburban cemetery in Western Australia, 1989, dry grass and red gravel paths
items.color_palette: ochre earth, sun-bleached grey stone, dusty pale blue sky
items.props_detail: a single jar of wilted wildflowers before a plain granite headstone
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon light, long gentle shadows
items.mood: still air, long shadows over endless rows, settled quiet
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y nueve ya habían muerto más de quinientos antiguos trabajadores y residentes de Wittenoom.

items.subject: a hall of former Wittenoom workers and widows, Anglo-Australian and Spanish and Italian migrants in their fifties and sixties, seen mostly from behind
items.action: they sit together on folding chairs as the first meeting of the society begins
items.gaze_interaction: heads turned toward a small table at the front; a thin grey-haired Spanish man in a cardigan leans forward, a heavy-set Australian woman in a floral dress rests a hand on his shoulder
items.setting: plain community hall in Perth, 1979, fibro walls, tea urn on a side table
items.color_palette: faded beige walls, brown wood, muted 1970s orange and olive clothing
items.props_detail: a hand-lettered sign-up sheet on the front table beside a tea urn
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the back of the hall
items.lighting: soft daylight through tall side windows
items.mood: shoulders close together, slow breathing, quiet warm light
items.narration_anchor: Los que seguían vivos se habían juntado diez años antes en la Asbestos Diseases Society of Australia.

items.subject: a judge in robe and wig at a high wooden bench, small in the distance, before a public gallery of elderly former miners, Anglo-Australian and Southern European men, thin and hunched
items.action: the judge reads the verdict aloud from a sheaf of pages
items.gaze_interaction: the gallery seen from behind, heads lifted toward the bench; an old Spanish man with a walking stick sits very upright, a gaunt Australian man beside him bows his head
items.setting: wood-panelled Supreme Court courtroom in Perth, 1988
items.color_palette: dark jarrah wood, deep red robe, cream walls, grey suits
items.props_detail: the sheaf of verdict pages under the bench lamp
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the rear of the gallery
items.lighting: soft diffuse daylight from high courtroom windows
items.mood: motionless backs, a shaft of pale light across the bench, hushed
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y ocho un juez leyó su veredicto: la compañía había mostrado un desprecio continuo, consciente y contumaz por la seguridad y la salud de sus trabajadores.

items.subject: a Spanish-born woman in her late sixties, slight build, short grey hair, hospital gown
items.action: she lies back as the scanner table slides her into the ring of the machine
items.gaze_interaction: eyes turned up to the ceiling, arms resting at her sides, shoulders slightly drawn in
items.setting: hospital imaging room in Perth, present day
items.color_palette: soft clinical white and pale grey, faint blue tint
items.props_detail: the curved opening of the CT scanner ring
items.mood: quiet hum of machinery, still body, calm pale light
items.narration_anchor: Mercedes de Juan, que se quedó en Australia, entra en un escáner y después sopla en un tubo.

items.subject: the same Spanish-born woman in her late sixties, slight build, grey hair, cardigan over a blouse, face weathered and lined
items.action: she blows hard into the mouthpiece of a spirometer tube during the lung function test
items.gaze_interaction: face to the front, cheeks drawn, eyes fixed on the readout beside her
items.setting: respiratory clinic room in Perth, present day
items.color_palette: soft white, pale grey, muted cardigan blue
items.props_detail: the spirometer tube connected to a small grey testing unit
items.lighting: soft diffused clinical light from a window
items.mood: one long held breath, shoulders lifted with effort, calm light
items.narration_anchor: «Nos hacen un escáner y una prueba de función pulmonar», dice Mercedes.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings on red earth
items.action: fine fibres lie loose and lift faintly in a breath of wind
items.gaze_interaction: focus falls on the fibres catching light against the red soil
items.setting: ground of the abandoned Wittenoom site, Pilbara
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, dusty blue-grey fibres
items.props_detail: a few loose fibres drifting just above the ground
items.lens_technique: macro lens, shallow depth of field
items.mood: suspended motes glowing in warm light, utter stillness
items.narration_anchor: Las fibras pueden causar mesotelioma, asbestosis y cáncer de pulmón.

items.subject: metal archive shelves of closed case-file boxes, the last row left unfilled
items.action: the shelving ends abruptly in an empty gap where the count stopped
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction leads along the boxes to the empty shelf
items.color_palette: grey steel, buff cardboard, faded manila
items.props_detail: the last labelled box beside an empty stretch of shelf
items.lighting: soft overhead light, dust in the air
items.mood: dust settling on untouched shelves, flat quiet light
items.narration_anchor: La cuenta oficial se detuvo. «El gobierno dejó de contar en 2.000, pero ahora se calcula que la cifra puede ser superior a los 4.000.

items.subject: Wittenoom buildings: the former police station and schoolhouse
items.action: the deserted buildings stand in the heat, a door swinging slightly in the wind
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction toward the empty schoolyard surfaced with pale blue-grey ground
items.setting: abandoned Wittenoom main street, Pilbara, red ranges behind
items.color_palette: rust red corrugated iron, faded white paint, ochre earth, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a rusted school bell post in the empty yard
items.mood: empty yard, long shadows, wind-stirred dust
items.narration_anchor: Y sigue aumentando», dice Melita Markey. Están enfermando hijos de policías y de maestros que trabajaron en el pueblo.

items.subject: the Wittenoom townsite from above, half its houses already gone
items.action: bare concrete slabs and empty lots spread where buildings once stood, a few remaining roofs among the scrub
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction across the thinning grid of streets toward the gorge
items.setting: Wittenoom in the Pilbara during progressive demolition, red ranges around
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, grey slabs, blue-grey tailings streaks
items.props_detail: a lone demolition truck parked on an empty street
items.mood: vast emptiness, long shadows over vacant lots, calm air
items.narration_anchor: Mientras los enfermos se contaban a sí mismos, el Estado decidió qué hacer con el pueblo: borrarlo.

items.subject: a weathered green road sign on a desert highway, Anglo-Australian road crew men in their forties, sun-browned, seen from behind
items.action: the crew unbolts and lowers the name panel from the sign beside their truck
items.gaze_interaction: workers face the sign, backs to camera, dust on their trousers
items.setting: Pilbara highway turn-off, red earth and spinifex, 2007
items.color_palette: faded road-sign green, red earth, ochre, clear dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: the name panel tilted down on the tray of the work truck
items.mood: heat haze, empty road to the horizon, slow deliberate work

text_in_image.location: on the sign panel being lowered

items.narration_anchor: Junio de dos mil siete; otras fuentes dicen dos mil seis. Wittenoom es abolido formalmente. Le quitan el nombre a las señales de la carretera y lo sacan de los mapas.

items.subject: Parliament House of Western Australia in Perth
items.action: the building stands calm at dusk as the government announcement is made
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction up the front steps to the lit windows
items.color_palette: pale sandstone, warm evening amber, deep blue sky
items.props_detail: the state flag on its pole above the entrance
items.mood: warm calm light, still flag, empty steps
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de «el fin de un período oscuro en la historia de nuestro Estado».

items.subject: members of a parliamentary inquiry, Anglo-Australian men and women in their forties and fifties in early-1990s suits, seen around a long table
items.action: they close a thick bound report recommending the tailings clean-up
items.gaze_interaction: a balding man in a grey suit rests his palm on the report; a woman with reading glasses looks toward the window
items.setting: committee room in Perth, 1992, wood panelling
items.color_palette: dark wood, navy and grey suits, beige paper
items.props_detail: the thick bound inquiry report at the centre of the table
items.mood: chairs pushed back, pale light across a closed report
items.narration_anchor: Quince años antes, en mil novecientos noventa y dos, una investigación parlamentaria había recomendado limpiar los relaves. El gobierno rechazó esas recomendaciones.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings dumps in Wittenoom Gorge
items.action: the abandoned heaps spill down the gorge floor beneath red cliffs
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the gorge toward distant mine openings
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, Pilbara, abandoned mine site
items.color_palette: deep red cliffs, ochre, blue-grey tailings, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: a rusted ore chute jutting from the cliff above the heaps
items.lighting: soft golden-hour light raking the cliffs
items.mood: immense scale, long shadows, motionless air
items.narration_anchor: «La minería en los desfiladeros ha dejado una contaminación que solo puede describirse como vergonzosa, incluso para los estándares de la época», dijo Larry Graham.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings along a dry creek bed
items.action: wind lifts a thin veil of dust off the tailings and carries it downstream
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction follows the drifting dust along the creek
items.setting: creek bed below Wittenoom Gorge, gum trees and red rocks
items.color_palette: red rock, pale sand, blue-grey dust, olive gum leaves
items.props_detail: a pale gum tree trunk dusted grey at its base
items.mood: glowing dust in the air, quiet wind, open space
items.narration_anchor: «Tenemos el deber de impedir una mayor dispersión de los relaves de asbesto», dijo Mark Nevill, por los residentes, por los visitantes, por las generaciones futuras.

items.subject: a typed government memo on a plain office desk
items.action: the memo lies filed and closed beneath a stapled cost estimate
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction onto the folder tab and the typed lines
items.color_palette: beige folder, white paper, grey laminate desk
items.props_detail: a manila folder with a tab label
items.mood: neat stillness, pale light on paper
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil dieciséis, los documentos dicen por qué los relaves siguen donde están: no porque no se pueda, sino por lo que cuesta.

items.subject: a Banjima elder in his seventies, lean, grey-bearded, in a faded work shirt and hat, seen from behind
items.action: he stands at the barricade at the edge of the forbidden zone as blue dust drifts past it across the road
items.gaze_interaction: facing out over the red ranges, shoulders squared, one hand resting on the barrier
items.setting: barricaded road into the abolished Wittenoom zone, Pilbara, 2023
items.color_palette: red earth, ochre, blue-grey drifting dust, warm gold sky
items.props_detail: the weathered steel barricade gate across the road
items.mood: small figure before a vast land, dust glowing in warm air, settled stillness
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintitrés, los estudios del Estado sobre hasta dónde llega la contaminación ya estaban desactualizados. Borraron el nombre del mapa. El polvo no leía mapas.
